result.title: Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference
result.summary: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VerKV：在 GPU 上保留少量与查询无关的 pivot token 及全量 KV 的 sketch，完整缓存放在 CPU；推理时先用 sketch 估计注意力近似的相对误差，仅当超出用户给定的 (ε, δ) 容差才从 CPU 取回更多 token，从而在有限误差下减少传输。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先用误差估计判断是否需要额外取回证据」的门控思路，可能对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 STOP/继续取证的决策成本权衡，可供核查；但该工作纯文本 KV 压缩，误差估计对多模态、空间结构化缓存的适用性尚待验证。
